tasks.short: Read plant specifications to determine products, ingredients and prescribed modifications

steps.what: Locate the current plant specifications for the assigned product and operation
Read specifications and determine products, ingredients and prescribed procedure modifications

tasks.design: Configure links from assigned operations in {OPS_SYSTEM} to controlled specifications in {DOCS}. Reduce navigation only; the operator still reads the full applicable requirements and resolves ambiguities through the existing procedure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct controlled version can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing document registers can link an operation to its current approved specification.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting prescribed changes in the actual plant context.
tasks.human_edge: The operator notices discrepancies between instructions and field conditions.
tasks.altitude: Less document lookup; no change in process authority.

reach.task: Check operating requirements against plant conditions

evidence.claim: Controlled document links can reduce lookup without removing specification interpretation; savings are an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is retrieving and reading specifications, excluding procedure authoring and process execution.

Document controller produces specification ID, revision, approval status and product or operation applicability through unchanged controlled-document work. Operator verifies assigned operation and applicability in s1's9 remaining hours. Missing or conflicting links require manual lookup and clarification; no free structured interpretation is assumed.
Test native document links first. Full reading and determination retain85 hours; existing automatic document retrieval earns no saving.
unknowns: Current controlled document register and lookup burden
research_questions: Do native links reduce navigation while preserving revision and applicability checks?

incremental.description: Maintain links and report missing specifications

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R94 gives6 gross minus2 upkeep net4. Low assumes only2 hours navigation removed; all85 reading and interpretation hours remain.

tasks.short: Notify maintenance engineers about equipment malfunctions

steps.what: Observe equipment malfunctions and identify the affected equipment and immediate symptoms
Notify maintenance engineers and clarify symptoms and urgency

tasks.design: Keep observation and direct maintenance notification through {TELEPHONY}. Automated alarms already support detection where present; they do not replace the operator's explanation and clarification.
tasks.previous_blocker: Symptoms and urgency depend on the actual plant situation.
tasks.enabler_now: No new supported capability removes the live handoff.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete symptoms and rapidly changing conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The operator explains what is observed without presenting a guess as diagnosis.
tasks.altitude: No change in notification time or maintenance authority.

evidence.claim: Contextual malfunction notification remains human work in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is observation and notification, excluding maintenance repair, separate log entry and emergency response.
Operator produces equipment identity, location, observed symptoms and immediate concern in s1's30 hours; no structured defect code is assumed. Uncertain causes remain explicit during the call.
Existing communications remain unchanged; no new upkeep is introduced, justifying zero incremental work.
research_questions: Is there repeated entry outside the actual notification that belongs in a separate record task?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 and zero upkeep; no observation or conversation time is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess the emergency and identify the applicable authorised response procedure
Implement emergency response actions and coordinate with the response team

tasks.design: Keep emergency assessment and authorised physical response with trained people. Existing emergency procedures in {DOCS} and engineered protection remain baseline controls; no model is inserted into emergency actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Emergencies require context, physical action and immediate coordination.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest does not support a change to emergency response labour.
tasks.human_edge: The operator follows trained response boundaries and communicates actual conditions.
tasks.altitude: No change in response time allocation or emergency authority.

evidence.claim: Emergency assessment and trained physical response remain human work in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is operator emergency response, excluding engineered automatic protection runtime and other responders' labour.
Operator assesses actual conditions in s1's20 hours; existing alarms are signals, not free structured clearance or diagnosis. Uncertainty follows existing emergency escalation procedures.
No new system, procedure or upkeep is introduced, justifying zero incremental work.
unknowns: Local emergency procedures and operator authority
research_questions: Which actions remain operator duties alongside existing engineered protection?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100, zero upkeep. Existing safety-system runtime is excluded from human effort and no new saving is claimed.

tasks.short: Direct workers assisting with process verification and material unloading

steps.what: Brief assisting workers on process control, verification or unloading activities
Direct activities, observe progress and resolve process or unloading problems

tasks.design: Keep briefing and field direction human. Existing work instructions in {DOCS} support the task; a schedule or dashboard does not replace observing assisting work and resolving immediate problems.
tasks.previous_blocker: Work direction depends on current conditions and worker understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported change removes actual supervisory attention.
tasks.still_hard: Coordinating safe unloading and process work as conditions change.
tasks.human_edge: The operator notices misunderstanding and adjusts direction promptly.
tasks.altitude: No change in direct coordination time or authority.

reach.learn: Clear task briefings and field observation

evidence.claim: Field direction and problem resolution remain human work in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary includes the focal operator's briefing and direction only; assisting workers' execution time is outside the savings denominator.
Operator confirms requirements, worker understanding and site constraints in s1's30 hours and observes progress in s2's70 hours. No structured worker-readiness or task-completion flag is assumed.
Existing instructions remain baseline tools. No new system or upkeep is introduced, justifying zero incremental work.
unknowns: Assisting work mix and coordination needs
research_questions: Is any substantial repeated administration separate from actual field direction?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 and zero upkeep; assisting workers' labour is excluded and focal coordination time remains.
